title: Engagement of Tenure Based DBW (Danger Building Worker) on Contract Basis
age_limit: Between 18 and 40 years as on the closing date of receipt of application

important_dates.label: Application Deadline
important_dates.date: 21 days from the date of publication of advertisement in Employment News

summary: Ordnance Factory Badmal, a unit of Munitions India Limited, invites offline applications from eligible Indian citizens for engaging 70 Danger Building Workers (DBW) on a tenure contract basis for an initial period of one year, extendable up to four years.
eligibility_bullets: Minimum qualification: NCVT certification (NAC) in AOCP Trade or specified feeder trades (IMCP, MMCP, LACP, PPO, Fitter General, Machinist, Turner, Sheet Metal Worker, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Boiler Attendant, Mechanic Industrial Electronics, Refrigeration and Air Conditioning Mechanic).
Age limit between 18 and 40 years with permissible relaxations for reserved categories.
how_to_apply_steps: Download and print the application form from the official Munitions India Limited website.
Fill out the application form completely in block letters.
Superscribe the envelope clearly with 'APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF TENURE BASED DBW ON CONTRACT BASIS'.
Attach self-attested copies of required educational qualifications, certificates, and extra self-attested photographs.
Forward the filled application by post to The Chief General Manager, Ordnance Factory Badmal, PO - Badmal, District - Balangir, Pin - 767070, ODISHA.
